---
title: "Adding another user on Omarchy"
status: mature
---

Create another local user with a home directory and the groups used on this setup.

```bash
sudo useradd -m -G wheel,network -s /bin/bash <user_name>
sudo passwd <user_name>
```

- `-m`: create the home directory
- `-G`: add supplementary groups
- `-s`: set the login shell

Check that the groups you specify exist and are appropriate for the account. In particular, membership in `wheel` normally grants access to administrative commands through sudo configuration.
